items.label: ADJUSTABLE BED SUPPORT LEGS

items.label: BED LEGS ROLE
items.value: some mattresses are so heavy that without proper center support, they may cause the bed slats or metal bed frames to bend or break; This bed center support legs adds the necessary support to your bed slats or bed frame, effectively protecting your bed base/ wooden slats/ platform bed frame from sagging and damage; save you money on bed repair and replacement

items.label: UPGRADE FEET BASE
items.value: the base of our bed legs is upgraded and improved. items.label: INSTALLATION METHOD
items.value: 1, Have holes to install: align the double holes on the bed legs with the double holes on the bed frame, then tighten the bolts and nuts; 2, Installation without holes: clamp the bed frame or bed slat with the bed leg and mounting auxiliary plate, then tighten the bolts and nuts, the specific effect can refer to the picture
